profile: Sustainability specialist with six years in climate and environmental performance management within an international business environment. Coordinates cross-functional reporting processes across group entities, analyses and interprets environmental performance data for sustainability management decisions, and maintains the Corporate Carbon Footprint on GHG Protocol methodology against defined emission reduction targets. Delivers CSRD and ESRS reporting alongside ESG ratings and sustainability-related stakeholder requests. Automated the reporting workflows behind a sustainability platform in Python, cutting manual data processing by 40%.

experience.title: LCA & Sustainability Consultant (Contract)
bullets: Calculate corporate and product carbon footprints across Scope 1, 2 and 3 on GHG Protocol methodology for building materials, industrial and automotive clients, and track results against their emission reduction targets
Model decarbonisation pathways and transition-risk exposure through CRREM 1.5 and 2 degree scenarios, then specify the measures that hold client portfolios on their climate targets
Drive climate-related supplier engagement on bill-of-materials product footprints, requesting material-level emissions data that extends Scope 3 coverage across the value chain
Validate ESG data across Scope 1, 2 and 3 and develop the sustainability KPIs behind client dashboards to audit-ready standard
Advise clients on EU sustainability regulation and compliance pathways, from ESPR, PPWR and EUDR obligations to green-claim substantiation
Pilot new compliance and data-collection processes on one client and product line, then extend them across the wider portfolio

experience.title: Sustainability Strategy and Stakeholder Dialogue (Work Study)
bullets: Coordinated the annual global environmental reporting process across multiple functions and legal entities, holding accurate data collection and consolidation on SAP and Power BI to published deadlines

Analysed environmental performance data spanning greenhouse gas emissions, water, waste and hazardous substances, and interpreted the findings for senior leadership to support sustainability management decisions

Configured and further developed the group sustainability reporting platform on osapiens, onboarded international subsidiaries entity by entity and trained global reporting contributors through e-learning modules on the SAP LMS
Aligned CSRD reporting with ESRS E1 alongside the senior disclosure team and prepared the assurance working papers and audit trails the external provider tested against
Set annual climate and ESG targets with their data-collection cycles, monitored attainment against the group emissions reduction pathway and contributed to the annual review of progress
Answered ESG ratings and investor questionnaires across S&P CSA, Sustainalytics, MSCI, ISS and EcoVadis, and compared the five methodologies to locate where scoring gaps sat
Assessed suppliers against ESG criteria alongside the sourcing functions, maintained the supply chain risk register and tracked remediation through to closure
Built and steered a cross-functional project team across Compliance, Risk, Legal, IT and supply chain, set its deliverables and held contributors to deadlines without direct authority

bullets: Served as primary point of contact for 150+ organisations globally, resolving emissions methodology, data-quality and disclosure deadline queries through a full reporting cycle
Owned environmental data collection and validation on the CDP platform, tracking submission coverage and data quality across organisations of differing size and maturity

bullets: Automated reporting workflows in Python, cutting manual data processing by 40%, and wrote the SQL validation rules behind a GRI-aligned sustainability reporting platform
